name: Truzzi-web
description: Truzzi — React Web clone of the customer Flutter app (jastip & suruh on-demand delivery)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,driver,admin,landing -c magenta,cyan,yellow,blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:jastiper" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix jastiper run build && npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix landing run build
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix web run type-check && npm --prefix server run type-check && npm --prefix jastiper run type-check && npm --prefix admin run type-check && npm --prefix landing run type-check
